newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain car demand up 20% in April - Industry Minister.
newsitem.headline: Spain car demand up 20% in April - Industry Minister.

text.p: Spanish Industry Ministry Josep Pique said on Tuesday demand for cars in April rose more than 20 percent, boosted by a recently-approved car aid scheme.
"The data, not official yet, show a rise in demand of above 20 percent," Pique told reporters in congress, before a speech to a parliamentary committee.
The Structural Programme for the Renovation of Vehicles, (PREVER) was approved on April 4 and provides subsidies to replace vehicles which are over 10 years old with new ones.
Pique added that in the first four months of the year car demand rose around 10 percent.

According to Spanish carmakers' association Anfac, in March car sales totalled 98,243 units, a rise of 2.24 percent on the same month in 1996, with total sales in the first quarter at 239,673 units, up 6.41 percent versus the previous year.
